sentences.en: Slovenia is a small country in Central Europe,
sentences.zh: 斯洛文尼亚是中欧的一个小国，

sentences.en: nestled between Italy, Austria, Croatia, and Hungary.
sentences.zh: 座落于意大利、奥地利、克罗地亚和匈牙利之间。

sentences.en: It's a land of snowy white peaks,
sentences.zh: 这是一个白雪皑皑的山峰、

sentences.en: green valleys, and turquoise rivers.
sentences.zh: 青翠的山谷和碧绿的河流交织的国度。

sentences.en: Beautiful in all seasons, although especially at Christmas
sentences.zh: 四季皆景，尤其是在圣诞

sentences.en: time.
sentences.zh: 时节。

sentences.en: It snowed really early on during my first winter here, and it was just magical.
sentences.zh: 我在那里的第一个冬天很早就下雪了，简直美得不可思议。

sentences.en: It felt
sentences.zh: 感觉

sentences.en: like I was walking through a Christmas card.
sentences.zh: 就像走在一张圣诞贺卡里。

sentences.en: That's reporter Will Aspinall.
sentences.zh: 那是记者威尔·阿斯平沃尔。

sentences.en: I moved here
sentences.zh: 我是在

sentences.en: from the UK with my wife and young family back in 2018 because we were enchanted with Slovenia's
sentences.zh: 2018年和妻子及年幼的家人从英国搬到这里的，因为我们被斯洛文尼亚的

sentences.en: landscape and wanted a new life for the kids.
sentences.zh: 风景深深吸引，并想为孩子们开启全新的生活。

sentences.en: And in that first year, we were really curious
sentences.zh: 而在那第一年里，我们非常好奇

sentences.en: what Christmas was going to be like in this snow globe of a country.
sentences.zh: 在这个犹如水晶球般的国家，圣诞节会是什么样子。

sentences.en: We love Christmas, and I thought we did it pretty well back in Britain.
sentences.zh: 我们热爱圣诞节，而且我觉得我们在英国时过得相当不错。

sentences.en: But let's just say, what Slovenia gets up to every December
sentences.zh: 但这么说吧，斯洛文尼亚每年十二月展现的阵仗

sentences.en: kind of blew us away.
sentences.zh: 着实让我们惊叹不已。

sentences.en: Like children in the US or the UK,
sentences.zh: 就像美国或英国的孩子一样，

sentences.en: Slovenian kids are visited by Santa Claus every Christmas Eve.
sentences.zh: 斯洛文尼亚的孩子们在每个平安夜都会迎来圣诞老人的造访。

sentences.en: They call him Bozicek.
sentences.zh: 他们管他叫博兹切克。

sentences.en: My most favorite is Bozicek.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的是博兹切克。

sentences.en: These are the voices of kids that I recorded at my daughter Marnie's elementary school.
sentences.zh: 这些是我在我女儿玛尼的小学录下的孩子的声音。

sentences.en: I like Santa because he brings me sweeties and pretzels.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢圣诞老人，因为他会给我带糖果和蝴蝶脆饼。

sentences.en: And that's Marni translating.
sentences.zh: 那是玛尼在做翻译。

sentences.en: But kids in Slovenia don't have to settle for just one Santa.
sentences.zh: 但斯洛文尼亚的孩子们可不必满足于只有一个圣诞老人。

sentences.en: They also have a more traditional option available,
sentences.zh: 他们还有一个更传统的选择，

sentences.en: a Catholic saint called Miklaus who dishes out the gifts on the night of December 5th.
sentences.zh: 一个叫做米克劳斯的基督教圣徒，会在12月5日晚上分发礼物。

sentences.en: And if you're a kid in Slovenia thinking,
sentences.zh: 如果你是个斯洛文尼亚小孩，心里想着，

sentences.en: geez, two Santas just really doesn't feel like enough,
sentences.zh: 天哪，两个圣诞老人真的远远不够，

sentences.en: well, don't worry.
sentences.zh: 别担心。

sentences.en: There is yet another option.
sentences.zh: 还有另一个选择。

sentences.en: He's a festive figure who comes down
sentences.zh: 他是一位节日人物，在每年元旦

sentences.en: from the country's highest mountain every New Year's Day
sentences.zh: 从该国最高峰走下来，

sentences.en: to shower the children of Slovenia with good wishes and yet more presents.
sentences.zh: 向斯洛文尼亚的孩子们倾注美好的祝愿和更多的礼物。

sentences.en: His name, if you didn't catch it, is Derek Maras, Grandpa FroSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你没听清的话，他的名字叫德里克·马拉思，严冬爷爷。

sentences.en: He's got a big beard and she's got a stick.
sentences.zh: 他有一把大胡子，她有一根手杖。

sentences.en: It was good we did it because we took a picture with him and had a fun time.
sentences.zh: 我们这么做真是太好了，因为我们和他合了影，玩得很开心。

sentences.en: If you're doing your sums, that means that this nation of just over 2 million people
sentences.zh: 如果你算一下，这意味着这个刚满两百万人口的国家，

sentences.en: is visited by not one, not two, but three different Santas every festive season.
sentences.zh: 在每个节日季都会迎来不仅一个、不仅两个，而是足足三个不同的圣诞老人。

sentences.en: As far as I know, they have the highest Santa to citizen ratio of any country in the world.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，他们拥有世界上所有国家中最高的圣诞老人与公民比例。

sentences.en: When I found out about Slovenia's three Santas, I had so many questions.
sentences.zh: 当我发现斯洛文尼亚有三个圣诞老人时，我产生了许许多多的疑问。

sentences.en: Why was one Santa not enough for these people?
sentences.zh: 为什么这些人一个圣诞老人还不够？

sentences.en: Where on earth did they all come from, and how did they manage to coexist?
sentences.zh: 他们到底都从哪儿冒出来的，又是怎么做到共存的？

sentences.en: It turns out that each Santa has had his moment in the spotlight,
sentences.zh: 事实证明，每个圣诞老人都曾有过属于自己的高光时刻，

sentences.en: each in a different period of Slovenia's complicated history.
sentences.zh: 每一个都出现在斯洛文尼亚复杂历史的不同时期。

sentences.en: And today, if you want a Christmas season that reflects that history and speaks to all Slovenians,
sentences.zh: 而今天，如果你想要一个既能反映这段历史又能代表所有斯洛文尼亚人的圣诞季，

sentences.en: you need all three magical men.
sentences.zh: 你需要这所有三个神奇的老头。

sentences.en: The people of Slovenia have long been protective of their customs and language,
sentences.zh: 斯洛文尼亚人民长期以来一直极力保护他们的习俗和语言，

sentences.en: and you can understand why.
sentences.zh: 你完全可以理解原因。

sentences.en: For hundreds of years, they were ruled by the Habsburg Empire,
sentences.zh: 几百年来，他们一直受哈布斯堡王朝统治，

sentences.en: one of the most powerful dynasties in Europe.
sentences.zh: 这是欧洲最强大的王朝之一。

sentences.en: Their language superficially was German because they were part of the empire.
sentences.zh: 由于他们是帝国的一部分，他们的表面语言是德语。

sentences.en: That's art historian and self-described Anglophone cheerleader of Slovenia, Noah Charney.
sentences.zh: 那是艺术史学家、自称为斯洛文尼亚英语啦啦队的诺亚·查尼。

sentences.en: But anyone living at home and going about their daily activities would have spoken Slovenian,
sentences.zh: 但任何住在家里并进行日常活动的人都会说斯洛文尼亚语，

sentences.en: And so that preservation of the language has helped keep them a relatively homogenous, solid group, despite all of the issues that plagued Europe over the past centuries.
sentences.zh: 因此，语言的保护帮助他们保持为一个相对同质、坚固的群体，尽管过去几个世纪欧洲饱受各种问题困扰。

sentences.en: The Slovenes were a distinct group of people with their own language, but they did share the same religion with almost all other subjects of the Habsburg Empire, Roman Catholicism.
sentences.zh: 斯洛文尼亚人是一个有着自己语言的独特群体，但他们与哈布斯堡帝国的几乎所有其他臣民有着共同的宗教信仰，那就是罗马天主教。

sentences.en: Roman Catholics loved their saints, and around Christmas time, there was only one saint that mattered.
sentences.zh: 罗马天主教徒热爱他们的圣徒，而在圣诞节前后，只有一个圣徒至关重要。

sentences.en: Enter Slovenia's first magical Christmas man, Saint Nicholas.
sentences.zh: 斯洛文尼亚的第一位神奇圣诞老人——圣尼古拉斯登场了。

sentences.en: Saint Nicholas, or Sveti Maclaus in Slovene, was a bishop born in the 3rd century CE.
sentences.zh: 圣尼古拉斯，或用斯洛文尼亚语称作斯韦蒂·马克劳斯，是一位出生于公元3世纪的主教。

sentences.en: There are a lot of stories that surround Saint Nicholas, some of them very gory and un-Christmassy,
sentences.zh: 围绕圣尼古拉斯有很多故事，其中一些非常血腥，一点也不像圣诞节，

sentences.en: but the one that matters for our purposes is about a poor old man who got so desperate he was about to sell his daughters into prostitution.
sentences.zh: 但对我们而言重要的是这样一个故事：一个可怜的老人陷入绝境，甚至打算把女儿卖去卖淫。

sentences.en: St. Nicholas intervened by delivering bags of gold coins to the man's house in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 圣尼古拉斯在半夜往那人的房子里送去了几袋金币，以此进行了干预。

sentences.en: St. Nick coming in with an extremely intense origin story.
sentences.zh: 圣尼古拉斯带来了一个极其重口味的起源故事。

sentences.en: And his saint day on December 6th is when Slovenian children traditionally received presents while they were sleeping,
sentences.zh: 他在12月6日的瞻礼日是斯洛文尼亚孩子们传统上在睡梦中收到礼物的时候，

sentences.en: just like those bags of gold one and a half millennia ago.
sentences.zh: 就像一个半世纪前的那些金币一样。

sentences.en: But the action really happened the night before, during Miklaussevanie, St. Nicholas Eve.
sentences.zh: 但真正的重头戏发生在头天晚上，也就是米克劳斯前夕。

sentences.en: In the capital, Ljubljana, there was a church-sponsored parade, with Maclaus at the centre, dressed like a Catholic bishop with that iconic pointed hat, golden slippers,
sentences.zh: 在首都卢布尔雅那，有一场教堂资助的游行，马克劳斯居于核心，他穿着像天主教主教一样的衣服，戴着标志性的尖顶帽、金色拖鞋，

sentences.en: and a curling bishop's staff.
sentences.zh: 手里拿着弯曲的主教手杖。

sentences.en: St. Nicholas in the Slovenian tradition is kindly, but he's accompanied by a group of little demons called parklni,
sentences.zh: 斯洛文尼亚传统中的圣尼古拉斯是慈祥的，但陪伴他的是一群被称为帕尔克利的小恶魔，

sentences.en: and their role is essentially as a tool to be used by parents to frighten children into being obedient.
sentences.zh: 他们的角色本质上是父母用来吓唬孩子以让他们听话的工具。

sentences.en: And these demons are supposed to carry around clanking chains that they drag you off with.
sentences.zh: 这些恶魔本该带着哗啦作响的铁链，把人拖走。

sentences.en: That is intensely spooky for our Christmas story.
sentences.zh: 这对于我们的圣诞故事来说实在是太诡异了。

sentences.en: Yeah, Miklausz Vanie really knocks Halloween into a cocked hat.
sentences.zh: 没错，米克劳斯前夕真的把万圣节秒得渣都不剩。

sentences.en: Some of the people I spoke to were genuinely traumatized by it,
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的一些人确实因此受到了心理创伤，

sentences.en: because in rural areas, people would actually dress up as these demons
sentences.zh: 因为在农村地区，人们真的会扮成这些恶魔，

sentences.en: and take the opportunity to torment local children.
sentences.zh: 并借此机会折磨当地的孩子。

sentences.en: Miklausz was Slovenia's only Santa for generations, until the 1940s.
sentences.zh: 几代人以来，马克劳斯一直是斯洛文尼亚唯一的圣诞老人，直到20世纪40年代。

sentences.en: when the country traded one empire for another and swapped Santas in the process.
sentences.zh: 当时这个国家经历了一个帝国换成另一个帝国，并在过程中换掉了圣诞老人。

sentences.en: When the Austro-Hungarian Empire crumbled after World War I,
sentences.zh: 当奥匈帝国在第一次世界大战后崩溃时，

sentences.en: the Slovene peoples decided to join a collection of six nations
sentences.zh: 斯洛文尼亚人民决定加入一个由六个国家组成的集合，

sentences.en: who identified themselves ethnically as Southern or Yugoslavs.
sentences.zh: 这些国家在民族上都认同为南方人或南斯拉夫人。

sentences.en: Yugoslavia was born.
sentences.zh: 南斯拉夫诞生了。

sentences.en: At first, Yugoslavia was a monarchy.
sentences.zh: 起初，南斯拉夫是一个君主国。

sentences.en: But after World War II, it became a communist country
sentences.zh: 但在二战后，它变成了一个共产主义国家，

sentences.en: led by a charismatic strongman named Josip Braz.
sentences.zh: 由一位极具个人魅力的强人约瑟普·布罗兹领导，

sentences.en: better known as Tito.
sentences.zh: 他更为人所知的名字是铁托。

sentences.en: Under Tito, Catholicism was suppressed
sentences.zh: 在铁托统治下，天主教遭到压制，

sentences.en: and St. Nicholas, a.k.a.
sentences.zh: 圣尼古拉斯，也就是

sentences.en: McCloush, was banned.
sentences.zh: 马克劳斯，被禁止了。

sentences.en: So after the World War II,
sentences.zh: 所以在二战之后，

sentences.en: the new Yugoslav communist authorities
sentences.zh: 新的南斯拉夫共产主义当局

sentences.en: wanted to banish religious customs from public life
sentences.zh: 想要从公共生活中驱逐宗教习俗，

sentences.en: and they wanted to replace them
sentences.zh: 并且他们希望用

sentences.en: with the new, let's say, socialist holidays.
sentences.zh: 可以说是全新的社会主义节日来取代它们。

sentences.en: That's Nina Jiddo, a curator at the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, who has researched this period.
sentences.zh: 这是斯洛文尼亚民族博物馆的馆员妮娜·吉多，她对这一时期进行了研究。

sentences.en: And I must say that I even met one man.
sentences.zh: 而且我必须说，我甚至遇到过一个人。

sentences.en: He was playing the role on San Nicolas, and then the police came.
sentences.zh: 他当时在扮演圣尼古拉斯，然后警察就来了。

sentences.en: And he told me that he was in the prison for two days because of playing the role of San Nicolas.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，因为扮演圣尼古拉斯，他在监狱里呆了两天。

sentences.en: Banning dressing up as a Catholic saint was one thing,
sentences.zh: 禁止扮成天主教圣徒是一回事，

sentences.en: but taking away presents for children during the darkest month of the year would have been
sentences.zh: 但在一年中最黑暗的月份里剥夺给孩子们的礼物，则是

sentences.en: unforgivable.
sentences.zh: 不可原谅的。

sentences.en: Tito knew that, and so he needed something, or rather someone, to take McClouch's
sentences.zh: 铁托深知这一点，因此他需要某种东西，或者更确切地说某个人，来取代

sentences.en: place.
sentences.zh: 马克劳斯的位置。

sentences.en: Exit McClouch, enter our next Magical Christmas Man.
sentences.zh: 马克劳斯退场，我们的下一个神奇圣诞老人登场。

sentences.en: At this point, Yugoslavia relied
sentences.zh: 当时，南斯拉夫依靠

sentences.en: on the Soviet Union for economic assistance, and Tito decided to borrow from its culture, too.
sentences.zh: 苏联的经济援助，铁托决定也借用其文化。

sentences.en: Since the 1930s, the Soviet Union had deployed a communist Santa to hand out the gifts.
sentences.zh: 自20世纪30年代以来，苏联就部署了一位共产主义圣诞老人来分发礼物。

sentences.en: And that figure is called in Russian,
sentences.zh: 那个形象在俄语中被称为

sentences.en: Dead Moroz, or Grandfather FroSt.
sentences.zh: “严寒老人”，即严冬爷爷。

sentences.en: In Slovenia, he's called Dedek Moraz.
sentences.zh: 在斯洛文尼亚，他被称为德德克·莫拉兹。

sentences.en: Dedek Moraz looked like an enormous bearded man from the Russian countryside.
sentences.zh: 德德克·莫拉兹看起来就像一个来自俄罗斯乡间的满脸大胡子的巨汉。

sentences.en: He would appear in factories, and if we're being pragmatic,
sentences.zh: 他会出现在工厂里，如果务实一点来看，

sentences.en: he was probably someone from the factory team dressed up.
sentences.zh: 他大概就是工厂团队里某个人假扮的。

sentences.en: The children would come to the factory,
sentences.zh: 孩子们会来到工厂，

sentences.en: and then they would have this positive association
sentences.zh: 然后他们就会对去工厂

sentences.en: with going to the factory
sentences.zh: 产生这种积极的联想，

sentences.en: and the parents would feel that the factory
sentences.zh: 而父母们会觉得工厂

sentences.en: was the one giving the gifts to their children
sentences.zh: 才是给他们的孩子送礼物的人，

sentences.en: and it's this good communist alternative
sentences.zh: 这是对天主教圣尼古拉斯或资本主义圣诞老人的一种良好的社会主义替代方案。

sentences.en: to Catholic Saint Nicholas or capitalist Santa Claus.
sentences.zh: 然而，一场政治危机差点在德德克·莫拉兹

sentences.en: But a political crisis threatened to end Dedek Moras
sentences.zh: 甚至还没机会传播节日欢乐之前就终结了他。

sentences.en: before he had even had a chance to spread the holiday cheer.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫·斯大林希望南斯拉夫

sentences.en: Joseph Stalin wanted Yugoslavia
sentences.zh: 成为苏联的傀儡国，

sentences.en: to become a puppet state for the Soviet Union
sentences.zh: 但铁托根本不吃这一套。

sentences.en: but Tito was having none of it.
sentences.zh: 斯大林对铁托的独立倾向并没有表现出好脸色。

sentences.en: And Stalin didn't take kindly to Tito's independence streak.
sentences.zh: 有明确的证据表明，斯大林曾试图在至少20个不同的场合暗杀他，

sentences.en: There is clear evidence that Stalin tried to have him assassinated on at least 20 different occasions,
sentences.zh: 包括使用诸如会释放毒气的音乐盒这样詹姆斯·邦德风格的小玩意。

sentences.en: including with such James Bond-like gadgetry as a music box that released nerve gas.
sentences.zh: 铁托最终在南斯拉夫取缔了所有苏联的影响，但他想保留德德克·莫拉兹，

sentences.en: Tito eventually outlawed all Soviet influence in Yugoslavia, but he wanted to keep Dedek
sentences.zh: 只是不想让他穿着俄国服装。

sentences.en: Mraz, just not dressed like a Russian.
sentences.zh: 他想要，你知道的，给他增添点南斯拉夫特色。

sentences.en: He wanted to, you know, Yugoslav him up a bit.
sentences.zh: 但铁托最初的尝试有点杂乱无章。

sentences.en: But Tito's initial attempts were a little haphazard.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个圣诞节里，严冬爷爷穿着士兵、矿工、水手甚至罢工工人的衣服出现。

sentences.en: Over the next few Christmases, Grandpa Frost appeared dressed up as a soldier, a miner, a sailor, even a striking worker.
sentences.zh: 基本上都是南斯拉夫无产阶级英雄的社会主义原型。

sentences.en: Basically, socialist archetypes of Yugoslav proletarian heroes.
sentences.zh: 一开始，这相当具有政治色彩，就像德德克·莫拉兹带着铁托的问候一样。

sentences.en: At the beginning, it was quite political, like Dedek Mraz was bringing the greetings from Tito.
sentences.zh: 但无论是原汁原味的俄罗斯德德克·莫拉兹，还是南斯拉夫的Cosplay版本，都没有真正在斯洛文尼亚流行起来。

sentences.en: But neither the original recipe Russian Dedek Morass or the Yugoslavian cosplay version really caught on in Slovenia.
sentences.zh: 人们根本不买账。
